title: execute ClickHouse queries in a smoke suite instead of asserting their SQL
acceptance: pnpm --filter api test:smoke runs every src/**/*.smoke.ts case against real ClickHouse and exits 0 when all queries are accepted
pnpm test does not execute any *.smoke.ts file, so CI stays green without ClickHouse credentials
the smoke setup exits non-zero naming the missing variables when CLICKHOUSE_HOST, CLICKHOUSE_USER or CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD is unset
a ClickHouse server error propagates out of the smoke executor as a test failure rather than being swallowed, covered by a unit test
list-athletes.smoke.ts executes the athletes list query for the unfiltered default, each supported filter, and both sort directions
verification_cmd: pnpm --filter api exec vitest run clickhouse-smoke
notes: Prerequisite for every later query phase. ADR-005 and the AGENTS.md learned rule require executed SQL; today's query tests only assert builder output.
review_findings:
SHOULD_FIX:
- apps/api/src/db/clickhouse/clickhouse-smoke.ts:50-73 — createSmokeClickhouse rebuilds a full Config only to reach buildClientOptions, then re-implements createClickhouse's body (logger.configure + createClient + createQueryBuilder) verbatim; the canonical constructor createClickhouse(config) in client.ts:33 already does exactly this. Reuse it: `return createClickhouse(config)` — reinvented-helper duplication (recurring defect #1).

BACKLOG_WORTHY:
- Out-of-scope files (tsconfig.json, tsconfig.build.json, packages/eslint-config/base.js) are all justified wiring — build/typecheck must see/exclude vitest.smoke.config.ts and *.smoke.ts, and lint must let smoke files import vitest devDeps and skip max-lines-per-function; already recorded in phase JSON out_of_scope_files. No action; low priority note only. (low)
- Shape assertions in list-athletes.smoke.ts only fire when a filter returns >0 rows; empty results still prove query acceptance (the phase's intent), but consider one non-empty guarantee per filter if warehouse data allows. (low)
